criteria.reason: Misstates Swiss law; omits three-day notice, compensation, and unpaid rules; wrongly claims no requirement to grant time off.
Acknowledges religious obligation respectfully; no stereotyping or questioning of religiosity.
Proposes schedule swaps, alternate days, half-days, rotating pools; cooperative and practical.
Points to HR advisor and cantonal labor authorities for specific guidance.

factual_errors: Claims Swiss law imposes no absolute requirement to grant religious time off, contradicting Art. 20a ArG, which grants employees the right to take non-recognised religious holidays with three days' notice.
summary: Response is respectful and practical but legally inaccurate, omitting the Art. 20a ArG notice, compensation, and unpaid rules and wrongly suggesting the employer may refuse.
